title: bupleurum ciliatum
intro: Bupleurum ciliatum, commonly known as Fringed Bupleurum, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. It is traditionally used in various forms of folk medicine, primarily in Asia and Europe, to treat a range of health conditions. The plant is valued for its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and hepatoprotective properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including pain relief and liver protection. The bioactive constituents of Bupleurum ciliatum include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties.
